cells: A stale 2016 README in the org's own tree asserts **AGPL** against a 2020 `LICENSE.md` saying **CC0**. No dated relicensing announcement found.
This is the mesh under every body we generate. The contradiction is upstream, not ours, but it is the single most load-bearing licence in the pipeline.

operatorRuling2026_09_10.question: A 2016 README in the upstream org tree asserts AGPL; a 2020 LICENSE.md in the same tree asserts CC0. No dated relicensing announcement was found. Which governs?
operatorRuling2026_09_10.ruling: The 2020 LICENSE.md SUPERSEDES the stale 2016 README. hm08 is CC0.
operatorRuling2026_09_10.reasoning: The later canonical licence file governs over stale README prose in the same tree.
operatorRuling2026_09_10.scope: hm08 base mesh, its teeth and its tongue, in every MakeHuman-derived body this project generates. Public RENDER is cleared by this ruling.
operatorRuling2026_09_10.reversibility: If an upstream owner states the README is the real grant, every derived asset is re-baked without hm08 and this ruling is withdrawn in place.
